changeSet.author: coop
changeSet.comment: Co-op Remix 0.1: new characters start with bigger inventories (config: coop.default_inventory_slots). Bump-only, never reduces grown slots.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE characters ALTER equipslots SET DEFAULT 32;
ALTER TABLE characters ALTER useslots SET DEFAULT 32;
ALTER TABLE characters ALTER setupslots SET DEFAULT 32;
ALTER TABLE characters ALTER etcslots SET DEFAULT 32;
UPDATE characters SET equipslots = GREATEST(equipslots, 32), useslots = GREATEST(useslots, 32), setupslots = GREATEST(setupslots, 32), etcslots = GREATEST(etcslots, 32);
